Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR drains agent-owned work before retiring storage and resumes interrupted deletion after restart. **Example:** Delete agent agentlife4 during a shell turn running sleep 30, then recreate the same agent. - **Before:** Deletion returned success with no removed paths, the turn continued, and recreation remained blocked by pending cleanup. - **After:** The turn aborted, seven paths were trashed, and the recreated agent answered reborn. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A useful lifecycle repair supported by live Gateway behavior, authority-loss traces, and released-writer upgrade evidence, with no new blocking code finding. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Sufficient (logs): Recorded real-provider Gateway flows exercise mid-turn deletion, recreation, surviving-agent work, and ordinary Stop; production-owner logs separately prove refusal after journal replacement, completion, and lease revocation. The later integration retains these owners, and unrelated UI parity images were not counted as deletion proof. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Deleting an agent during a turn can report success while execution continues, cleanup remains pending, and recreating the agent fails. **Reason:** The demonstrated lifecycle failure warrants repair, and maintainer authorship establishes direction for the durable draining phase. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR fixes a demonstrated active-deletion failure that current main still has, and no new blocking patch defect was found. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856` ## Before merge - [ ] **Complete next step** - Resolve the confirmed GitHub conflict and qualify the optional-identity, session-wire-speed, and test-types failures in run 38183516423; repair demonstrated PR-caused failures and retain independently established inherited failures through the authorized native landing path. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Gateway and CLI deletion enter the agent lifecycle owner, which coordinates admission, cancellation, memory settlement, database retirement, and filesystem cleanup through a durable journal. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Gateway or CLI deletion] --> B[Deletion journal and lease] B --> C[Close agent work admission] C --> D[Cancel and settle runtime owners] D --> E[Drain memory and retire storage] E --> F[Purge sessions and trash files] F --> G[Complete journal and allow recreation] B --> H[Restart recovery] H --> C ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Complete agent-scoped draining and restart recovery through the existing lifecycle and storage owners before retiring durable data. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source still retires storage without first draining active agent work, matching the reported real-Gateway baseline; this read-only review did not rerun it. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes: the repair uses existing cancellation and storage owners, retains accepted settlement, scopes cancellation to the deleted agent, and records restart continuation without adding configuration. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [8a39ccbb2245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8a39ccbb22457a001dbcc43f776cccc68b903bf5). ### Provenance checked - `Transactional deletion and recreation fences` keeps the original intent (8a5b4af660748aef0c95c47e21be52375b00482c: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111678 established durable deletion ownership, cleanup retries, and protection against inherited command authority on ID reuse.) - `Memory and reader retirement ordering` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (40d284f9a6aaa6b11f6d9d7bc1db253781d7ef76: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159013 closes deleted-agent resources while preserving surviving physical owners; this PR explains why memory settlement must precede database retirement.) - `Plugin-state comparison mutations` keeps the original intent (01e189266093d01ebe4973229c9a2c5dcc1f42ba: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168635 sought fewer repeated observations while preserving TTL and quota contracts; the introduced diff reuses canonical mutation functions inside the existing comparison transaction.) - `Ordinary Stop and session drain bounds` keeps the original intent (80e18aafb9e6e36ec6a721e5a0312f3df6cf0768: The merged change made Stop reach OpenAI-compatible HTTP work; this PR retains that cancellation path and confines additional unbounded local settlement to agent deletion.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main still lacks active-work draining:** The fetched main deletion handler begins database retirement without the PR's preceding agent-wide runtime drain; its ordering matches the reported live baseline failure. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/agents.ts:475`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8a39ccbb22457a001dbcc43f776cccc68b903bf5/src/gateway/server-methods/agents.ts#L475), [8a39ccbb2245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8a39ccbb22457a001dbcc43f776cccc68b903bf5)) - **Drain before retirement:** The reviewed implementation drains exact agent-owned runs and closes the memory owner before advancing the journal to retiring; RPC and restart recovery use the same deletion implementation. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete.ts:158`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856/src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete.ts#L158), [b62417774a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856)) - **Live authority refusal evidence:** The discussion at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168199#issuecomment-6107382256 supplies six production-owner traces covering replaced, completed, and revoked deletion authority for unkeyed and protected work: accepted cancellation settles and the later work item remains uncancelled. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete-drain.test.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856/src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete-drain.test.ts), [b62417774a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856)) - **Released-writer upgrade compatibility:** The full body and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168199#issuecomment-6114697286 record successful copied-state upgrades from v2026.9.9 and v2026.10.1 on parent bea9bb26328cd431e30fac56ec6d617254f4511d, preserving keeper settings, session JSON, transcript bytes, workspace contents, and integrity. A targeted parent-to-head diff confirms the deletion journal, recovery, and phase-installation owners are unchanged. ([`src/state/openclaw-state-db-schema-additive.ts:136`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856/src/state/openclaw-state-db-schema-additive.ts#L136), [b62417774a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856)) - **Complete CI disposition remains unresolved:** REST job reads for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38183516423 confirm ten failed roots plus the aggregate gate, with security-fast passing. The current body explicitly leaves optional connection identity, session wire speed, and check-test-types-core-2 unqualified; passing baseline replays are not claimed as inheritance evidence. ([b62417774a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856)) - **Confirmed current-head conflict:** Fresh REST reads retain the reviewed head and report mergeable=false and mergeable_state=dirty. ([b62417774a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b62417774a44610061fd95988ec03e12d9f0f856)) Likely related people: - **Chris Eckert:** Raw commit 40d284f9a6aaa6b11f6d9d7bc1db253781d7ef76 adds src/agents/agent-delete-databases.ts:41 relative to its recorded parents. This identifies author metadata, not feature responsibility or a PR merger. Label justifications: - `P2`: Active agent deletion can leave cleanup pending and prevent same-name recreation; the failure is limited to this lifecycle operation. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. @clawsweeper re-review

The completed review of `223616b9a5baa2c9a06c88c398a8b3528fbc723d` repeats revision 11's evidence request and cites an older captured body. Please read the current PR body section **Fifth follow-up (head 223616b9a5ba)**. No new security defect was confirmed in revision 12. The following evidence already exists for this exact head.

The committed authority cases in `src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete-drain.test.ts` use real journal replacement/completion and lease revocation through the production cancellation owners. They demonstrate accepted cancellation settlement and refusal of the later work item. These are production-owner boundary tests with synthetic work handles, not live-provider authority-loss traces; that distinction is intentional.

# Runtime authority-loss evidence

All six cases passed through the production owners with a real deletion journal and lease. The first work item remained unsettled until explicitly released after a real asynchronous journal read; the later work item was never cancelled.

```text
unkeyed / replaced
  accepted owner trace: aborting run: sessionId=unkeyed-replaced-first
  later cancellation rejected: Error: Agent doomed deletion no longer owns database cleanup.
  laterCancelled=false
unkeyed / completed
  accepted owner trace: aborting run: sessionId=unkeyed-completed-first
  later cancellation rejected: Error: Agent doomed deletion no longer owns database cleanup.
  laterCancelled=false
unkeyed / revoked
  accepted owner trace: aborting run: sessionId=unkeyed-revoked-first
  later cancellation rejected: OpenClawStateLeaseError: agent deletion core:agent-deletion/doomed was lost
  laterCancelled=false
protected / replaced
  accepted owner trace: {"runId":"protected-replaced-first","stream":"lifecycle","data":{"phase":"end","status":"cancelled","aborted":true,"stopReason":"delete","startedAt":1,"endedAt":1791699688052}}
  later cancellation rejected: Error: Agent doomed deletion no longer owns database cleanup.
  laterCancelled=false
protected / completed
  accepted owner trace: {"runId":"protected-completed-first","stream":"lifecycle","data":{"phase":"end","status":"cancelled","aborted":true,"stopReason":"delete","startedAt":1,"endedAt":1791699693734}}
  later cancellation rejected: Error: Agent doomed deletion no longer owns database cleanup.
  laterCancelled=false
protected / revoked
  accepted owner trace: {"runId":"protected-revoked-first","stream":"lifecycle","data":{"phase":"end","status":"cancelled","aborted":true,"stopReason":"delete","startedAt":1,"endedAt":1791699700046}}
  later cancellation rejected: OpenClawStateLeaseError: agent deletion core:agent-deletion/doomed was lost
  laterCancelled=false
```


Published-writer upgrade proof on the exact head passed for **both v2026.9.9 and latest stable v2026.10.1**, using each release's own maintained journal writer to create an unfinished phase-less journal. Each fresh copied fixture passed Doctor preflight, startup maintenance, resumeAgentDeletions, owner closure/reopen, and recreation. Keeper config, UI preferences, session entry JSON, transcript event bytes and workspace survived; all four databases reported `ok`. Shared schema remains **20**; the sole PR schema addition is nullable `agent_deletion_journal.phase TEXT` with no default. Default 120-second test deadlines were retained: test bodies 20.819 s / 18.842 s, full runners 82.544 s / 77.511 s, both exit 0. The committed historical regression is `src/gateway/server-methods/agents-delete.upgrade.test.ts`.

The fifth follow-up also records exact-head real-provider Gateway proof: delete during a shell turn, recreate and answer; concurrent surviving-agent work completes; ordinary Stop on both runtimes aborts within 3 ms and permits the next turn. Retained-resource owner regressions cover connection terminals, exec settlement, MCP and browser cleanup; the offline owner proof above is not represented as a live-provider run.

I am resolving the confirmed conflict with main through the native maintainer workflow and will refresh exact-head review and the required regressions afterward.
